text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Fourth Sidon alcohol shop destroyed by explosion.
- Walid Jumblatt, Minister of Displaced People, condemns the government for resorting to a show of military force to quell a civil disobedience campaign.
- Maronite League leader claims his community is "restless".
- Government to spend $185 million on projects in poor areas.
- Prime minister heads for Damascus for talks on boosting trade.
- New clean-up campaign for the country.
- Lebanon and Syria to hold economic talks in Damascus on Tuesday.
- Lebanese parties to hold their first meeting since the end of the civil war.
- Two Israeli air raids on area south of Beirut.
